detail.longDescription: I wanted a meaningful benchmark for Mistral 4, and as a fan of Blood Bowl, I'm faintly aware that it's a hugely challenging game to build AI for... Hence the regular Bot Bowl[1] tournament, and now Bot Bowl Bench! I've kept it to cheap-ish models for now, but if people find it fun, might add Opus + Astra and see how they get on! [1] https://njustesen.github.io/botbowl/
